premise: In a town where every kind act makes one of your accessories jump onto the person you helped, a colourful outsider keeps helping anyway.
world_rule: In Mirrowick, every time you do something kind for someone, one accessory you are wearing jumps onto them. The hidden half of the rule: when the helped person says thank you, a brand new copy comes back to the helper, brighter.
logline: Milo arrives covered in hats and scarves, searching for his missing sister, and gives everything away until one thank-you reveals what the rule really means.

beats.hook: In this town, being kind will cost you everything you're wearing.
beats.rule: Three fast examples (bag/hat, lunch/glasses, door/scarf), then nobody helps anybody; Milo arrives covered in accessories with a secret.
beats.conflict: Milo helps Pip and loses his red cap, but his hair glows gold; Mayor Tilda tells him to stop and he refuses.
escalation: Baker gets Milo's green scarf; the square starts to fill with colour
The town fights; people hide from kindness
Milo is left with nothing and finds a trail of tiny accessories
beats.reveal: The trail leads to the Lost and Found cellar: Lena, Milo's missing sister, has been secretly helping the town every night and gave away everything, even the red scarf he knitted her.
beats.resolution: Pip says thank you and a new red cap appears on Milo: kindness was never lost, it waited for thanks. The baker thanks Milo and the town thanks Lena; everything returns, brighter.
beats.ending: Second twist: the town thanks Mayor Tilda, who once gave everything, and a golden crown appears. Sequel hook: a locked chest 'for the one who was helped first'.
